item.text:
Implemented the share availability check in [useDefaultShare.ts](/app/applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useDefaultShare.ts:58). It forwards the supplied abort signal and share ID to `getShare`, returning `false` for locked or soft-deleted shares. [FolderContainer.tsx](/app/applications/drive/src/app/containers/FolderContainer.tsx:43) now redirects unavailable folder URLs to the root and ignores stale route results. The default-share loading path remains intact.

A subagent reviewed the route behavior, and another drafted the [folder route tests](/app/applications/drive/src/app/containers/FolderContainer.test.tsx:69); I reviewed the tests and corrected the redirect assertions. **Verification passed:** 10 focused tests, the Drive type check, and formatting checks. The tests include the existing single volume creation behavior.
